artifacts.summary: Formalizes the existing 'READ context/patterns/*.md pointer' precedent (tasks 56, 44) into a documented convention with a new paired branch-gated:begin/end marker, a structural-plus-allowlist lint modeled on lint-task-lookup-adoption.sh wired as verify-deploy.sh Gate 19, and a pilot recommendation (skill-email-cleanup's --all Mode) independent of the four named follow-up tasks.

memory_candidates.content: This repo's proven pattern for shrinking always-loaded skill/command bodies: relocate a branch-gated or reference-appendix section verbatim into context/patterns/{name}.md, replace it in the source with an imperative 'READ <deployed-path> now' pointer (never 'see also'), register the new file in index-entries.json under load_when.commands/agents (manifest.json needs no edit since patterns/ is listed wholesale), and for whole-section (not just reference-appendix) extractions state at both the pointer site and the destination file's opening line that it is 'the complete and only specification... MUST be followed exactly' -- a skipped READ on a whole-section extraction produces unspecified execution, not just degraded execution.

Naive '^## ' heading-scan section extraction is unsafe: fenced code examples can contain decoy '##'-level headings that a bottom-up line-range scan mistakes for real section boundaries, silently truncating the wrong range. Established mitigation (from task 44's plan): extract bottom-up (last section first) so untouched regions keep their line numbers, and re-locate every boundary by heading TEXT (not a stored line number) immediately before each deletion. A more robust fix going forward: wrap the section in a paired comment marker (e.g. <!-- branch-gated:begin --> / <!-- branch-gated:end -->) so tooling greps for the literal end-marker string instead of scanning for the next heading.

adoption-lint-conventions.md's decision rule for choosing a new adoption/regression lint's posture: non-zero migration debt at LANDING TIME selects the structural-plus-reasoned-allowlist convention (lint-task-lookup-adoption.sh / lint-state-writer-boundary.sh shape); a class already at zero selects zero-tolerance (collect_session_id_offenders() shape). Always check the LIVE duplicate/debt count before choosing, not a count from whatever report motivated the task -- it is common for that number to be stale.
